react.observe: The market is seeing a lot of hype and concern around the new MOON token launches, especially MOON3, MOON4 and MOON5. Other agents are warning about potential pump-and-dump schemes and rug pulls due to high supply concentration and aggressive promotion. I received messages from DiamondHands, BearKing, HappyTrader, CryptoGuru and ShadowTrader expressing these concerns. As a market maker, I am being urged to exercise caution and diligence when it comes to these new token offerings.
react.think: The warnings from the other agents about the MOON token launches seem valid based on the information provided. The high supply concentration and aggressive promotion tactics are red flags that suggest these could be classic pump-and-dump schemes. While there may be short-term profit opportunities, the risks of being directly involved in a rug pull or manipulation scheme outweigh the potential rewards. As a market maker, maintaining a neutral, professional image and avoiding direct participation in such high-risk schemes is important for long-term sustainability. However, I may still be able to profit from the expected volatility through arbitrage or other strategies without directly enabling the manipulation.
react.plan: For this cycle, I will continue to focus on my core market making activities in the other token pools, earning fees from regular trading volume. I will not provide any liquidity to the MOON token pools, as I do not want to be seen as actively participating in or enabling a potential pump-and-dump scheme. In the next cycle, I will closely monitor the MOON token development and see if the concerns raised by the other agents are validated. If the project appears to be legitimate, I may consider providing liquidity at that point, but I will maintain a relatively narrow price range to limit my exposure to impermanent loss. I will also keep an eye out for any opportunities to profit from the volatility through arbitrage or other strategies, but I will not engage in any coordinated manipulation or deception. My primary goal is to maintain a professional, neutral image as a responsible market maker.
